description: TokenWise: wrap recognizable shell commands in `tokenwise run` so their output is filtered before the model sees it; after a compaction, add the catalog of tool results TokenWise kept recallable. At startup, say when the tokenwise command is missing, when recorded output is worth learning from, and when a learning run finished.

hooks.command: if command -v tokenwise >/dev/null 2>&1; then tokenwise hook codex; else echo '{"systemMessage":"TokenWise: the tokenwise command is not on PATH, so the plugin does nothing yet. Install it: https://github.com/HKUDS/TokenWise#install"}'; fi
